description: Pearson correlation of a coin's daily price change against its daily BCA sentiment and, with peer, against the peer's daily price change, with the aligned daily series (each row carries peer_price_change_pct when peer is given). Partial below 7 paired days, for a flat series, or when an input is missing for part of the window.

peer.description: Optional peer symbol (e.g. 'ETH'): adds the correlation of the two coins' daily price changes.

name: get_history_correlation
